description_en: You can call the OnsInstanceUpdate operation to update the name and description of an instance
description_zh: 调用OnsInstanceUpdate接口更新实例名称和描述
name: OnsInstanceUpdate

parameters.help_en: The updated description of the instance. If you leave this parameter empty, the description is not updated
parameters.help_zh: 更新后的实例描述，传空值则不更新
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The updated name of the instance. The name must meet the following requirements:

The instance name must be unique in the region where the instance is deployed.

The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

If you leave this parameter empty, the name is not updated
parameters.help_zh:
更新后的实例名称。取值说明如下：
实例名称在该实例所部署的地域下要唯一，不可重名。

长度限制为3~64个字符，可以是中文、英文、数字、短划线（-）以及下划线（_）。

传空值则不更新
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance whose name or description you want to update
parameters.help_zh: 待更新名称或描述的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is unique to each request. Use this ID to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
